description.fun: A steel earthworm that lives in arid deserts, keeping its metal body in shape by eating iron out of the soil. Attack it and it fights back with the tendrils along its body, pelting you with a storm of punches, though it can't actually learn any punching moves. A giant one, the Lurking Steel Titan, lives in Paldea's East Province.
description.guide: A Steel-type earthworm Pokémon from Pokémon Scarlet and Violet that eats iron from desert soil. Its segmented body also resembles a train. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A metal earthworm that punches with its tendrils
